newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares remain buoyant in post-bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares remain buoyant in post-bourse trade.

text.p: 1415 GMT - German shares remain buoyant in post-bourse IBIS computer dealings as DAX index holds on to record gains. DAX ended bourse at seventh consecutive record high, traders see no end in sight to advance but warn that gains must slow. Firmer dollar and Wall Street gains continue to underpin market.
* IBIS DAX up 18.42 points at 4,048.52, new high at 4,067.51 points. DAX ended bourse up 49.46 points at 4,055.86.
* Metro down after says too much fantasy in share.
* Bank shares in top volumes. Deutsche ends bourse up 90 pfennigs at 104.40 marks, Dresdner up 3.15 marks at 68.20 marks, Commerzbank up 1.50 at 52.20 marks.
